Fox Witch 3D

The Fox of the Moon Faire in 3D. In progress: the Fox in her corset, patchwork trousers, boots and bracelets, with her own painted face on the Jester's head shape. Her hair and bracelets swing. Belt, pouch, tools and spells come next.

Drag to turn her; pinch or scroll to zoom. Walk around puts a round pad on the stage: drag it and she walks the way you push; push to the edge and she runs. On a keyboard use W A S D or the arrow keys, Shift to run, Space to jump. Body is how she holds herself: it stays until you pick another. Moves play once over whatever she is doing. She has no spells yet. What you see under her bodice is charcoal leggings, as in painting B4: that is her body before the trousers go on.
